pluss::subsp::stats::ts::LjungBoxOptions¶

Options of ts::ljung_box.

LjungBoxOptions selects the lag sets to test and the correction for fitted model coefficients.

Fields¶

Field

Type

Default

Meaning

lags

std::vector<std::int64_t>

{10}

The lag sets: one test is run for each, using autocorrelations at lags 1 up to that value.

model_df

std::int64_t

0

Degrees of freedom to subtract: the number of ARMA coefficients estimated when the input is a residual series.

norm

ts::AcfNorm

Biased

Normalisation of the autocovariances, as in AcfOptions.

demean

bool

true

Subtract the sample mean first; turn off for residuals whose mean is zero by construction.

Guidance¶

The defaults are a sensible starting point; change a field only for the reason its row gives.
